episodes.synopsis: High school biology teacher Lucas Amato finds a tube with a glowing green ooze and takes it home with him. The next night a woman named Cybersix visits Lucas to retrieve the ooze called Sustenance. But before she has a chance to get it, a big strange man breaks into Lucas's apartment.
episodes.title: Mysterious Shadow

episodes.synopsis: Cybersix's creator sends his bioroid black panther pet called Data 7 to kill her.
episodes.title: Data 7 & Julian

episodes.synopsis: Jose creates a mud monster from primordial ooze which can change its shape to counter any attack and sends it after Cybersix.
episodes.title: Terra

episodes.synopsis: Jose tries to hire a detective to help him capture Cybersix. When he refuses, Jose kidnaps his sister and will only return her in exchange for Cybersix.
episodes.title: Yashimoto, Private Eye

episodes.synopsis: Lori bumps into Jose and accidentally gets her CD switched for the CD-ROM he's using to program his tunneling robot that's going to dig into the city's treasury.
episodes.title: Lori Is Missing

episodes.synopsis: Jose uses one of Von Riecher's creations to control birds and have them attack the people of Maridiana.
episodes.title: Blue Birds of Horror

episodes.synopsis: Jose uses special devices to brainwash six police officers and force them to hunt down Cybersix.
episodes.title: Brainwashed

episodes.synopsis: Cybersix is attacked by goblin-like creatures that seem to fear the light.
episodes.title: Gone with the Wings

episodes.synopsis: After being bitten by a wolfman Lucas finds himself getting hairier and becomes fascinated by the new teacher.  Cybersix resents her influence over him but she's too busy fighting the wolfwoman Dr. Von Reichter has sent to hunt her.
episodes.title: Full Moon Fascination

episodes.synopsis: Von Riecher gifts Jose a strange egg that hatches into a soul-absorbing floating eye. Jose takes the eye to the city and soon the entire population, except for Cybersix, is soulless.
episodes.title: The Eye

episodes.synopsis: Jose builds a bunch of mechanical animals and starts his own circus, The Greatest Show In Meridiana. Suspicious, Cybersix goes to the circus, only to be captured.
episodes.title: The Greatest Show in Meridiana

episodes.synopsis: While on a school fieldtrip Cybersix is attacked by a techno with the power to become invisible.
episodes.title: Daylight Devil

episodes.synopsis: A living island created by Dr Von Reichter begins making its way to Meridina harbour. It is programmed to explode once it arrives because he's tired of Jose's many failures and wants to wipe the slate clean.
episodes.title: The Final Confrontation
